verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for a hosted memory platform like Mem0, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions pricing pages, a free tier, plan limits or per-unit rates. The open-source self-hosting option is a different deployment path, not published pricing, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published pricing with a free tier and per-unit rates so I can project memory costs before committing
